sourceRows.interpretation: Subscription preflight passed static gates but still has runtime blockers for controlled live user, provider setup and real invoice/payment proof.
Latest Grow compliance evidence shows public checkout/legal-policy checks, but provider KYC/product mapping and real payment proof remain separate blockers.

gateRows.source_evidence: Manual invoice checkout path exposes payer fields and legal approval links.
gateRows.next_action: Use as a no-charge fallback path while live provider checkout remains blocked.
gateRows.owner_notice: This confirms the fallback surface exists; it does not create a payment link or invoice.

gateRows.source_evidence: Lawyer onboarding stores payment follow-up status, manual link and invoice reference.
gateRows.next_action: Owner/admin can use the queue only for an approved controlled lawyer record.
gateRows.owner_notice: No email is sent and no lawyer record is edited by this packet.

gateRows.source_evidence: Lawyer dashboard exposes structured billing/service request presets.
gateRows.next_action: Use service requests for payment-link, invoice, refund, cancellation, upgrade and downgrade drills.
gateRows.owner_notice: Dashboard requests create review queues; they do not mutate provider subscriptions by themselves.

gateRows.source_evidence: Dashboard handlers define the billing/service request types and save handler.
gateRows.next_action: Controlled live drills should verify each request type lands in owner review before any provider action.
gateRows.owner_notice: Refund/cancel/upgrade/downgrade must stay owner-reviewed and provider-confirmed.

gateRows.source_evidence: CRM qualified lead queue stores billing status, invoice reference and evidence URL.
gateRows.next_action: Use only after lead consent, accepted lawyer/supplier terms, owner release and billing contact exist.
gateRows.owner_notice: This packet does not create leads, assign lawyers or send invoices.

gateRows.source_evidence: CRM save handler downgrades an attempted paid status to invoice_sent when proof is missing.
gateRows.next_action: Mark paid only when invoice/reference or payment evidence exists.
gateRows.owner_notice: This is the key anti-overclaim guard for first paid lead reporting.

gateRows.source_evidence: Grow compliance checker writes private reports and checks manual invoice/legal-policy markers.
gateRows.next_action: Rerun live compliance before a provider approval/payment walkthrough.
gateRows.owner_notice: Live provider KYC/product mapping remains outside this static private packet.

gateRows.source_evidence: Subscription preflight explicitly separates static pass from runtime payment/provider blockers.
gateRows.next_action: Keep manual proof ledger until controlled live provider/payment drills are approved.
gateRows.owner_notice: Subscription revenue cannot be counted from static proof alone.

operatorRows.allowed_action: Use one owner-approved controlled lawyer, supplier or lead only.
operatorRows.required_evidence: Owner approval, source record type and no-PII internal reference.
operatorRows.blocked_without: Owner approval and controlled test scope.
operatorRows.forbidden_action: Do not bulk import, message old leads, create public records or contact partners.
operatorRows.source_context: Preflight: PASS_WITH_RUNTIME_BLOCKERS; Grow: 8 Grow compliance passes.

operatorRows.allowed_action: Confirm accepted terms, per-lead or subscription fee, billing contact and invoice recipient.
operatorRows.required_evidence: Accepted terms status, agreed fee, billing contact yes/no.
operatorRows.blocked_without: Accepted lawyer/supplier terms or billing contact.
operatorRows.forbidden_action: Do not route paid leads or send invoice requests without terms and fee clarity.
operatorRows.source_context: Onboarding and CRM both store payment/status references but still require real owner/admin evidence.

operatorRows.allowed_action: Prepare a no-PII manual invoice/request packet for owner/operator use.
operatorRows.required_evidence: Plan/lead type, amount, owner-approved source ID, no sensitive chat or payment data.
operatorRows.blocked_without: Billing contact, accepted terms and owner release.
operatorRows.forbidden_action: Do not send an invoice, email, WhatsApp or provider request from this generated packet.
operatorRows.source_context: The generated template is blank on purpose and must be filled in the approved private system.

operatorRows.allowed_action: After the owner manually sends the invoice/payment request, record the invoice/reference and set invoice_sent.
operatorRows.required_evidence: Invoice reference or private payment-request reference.
operatorRows.forbidden_action: Do not mark paid at this stage.
operatorRows.source_context: Lead CRM and lawyer onboarding both support invoice/manual payment references.

operatorRows.allowed_action: Set paid only after invoice/reference or payment evidence URL exists.
operatorRows.required_evidence: Invoice/reference, receipt/payment proof URL or owner evidence link.
operatorRows.forbidden_action: Do not count revenue, announce first paid lead or update paid_at without evidence.
operatorRows.source_context: CRM paid-status guard prevents paid with empty invoice/reference and empty payment evidence URL.

operatorRows.allowed_action: Use dashboard service requests for upgrade, downgrade, cancellation, invoice copy and refund review.
operatorRows.required_evidence: Service request row, owner decision, provider action result and reference if money moved.
operatorRows.blocked_without: Controlled live lawyer dashboard and provider/admin confirmation.
operatorRows.forbidden_action: Do not mutate live provider subscription state directly from a chat request.
operatorRows.source_context: Dashboard presets and handlers exist; live drills remain runtime blockers.

templateRows.allowed_next_action: Owner may send manual payment link/invoice only after terms and billing contact are complete.
templateRows.forbidden_action: Do not mark paid from registration alone.

templateRows.allowed_next_action: Set ready_to_bill or invoice_sent only after consent, terms, owner release and billing details exist.
templateRows.forbidden_action: Do not route or bill an old lead without fresh permission.

templateRows.allowed_next_action: Keep lead packet, invoice reference and payment proof together before first-paid-lead claim.
templateRows.forbidden_action: Do not announce first paid lead before proof exists.

templateRows.allowed_next_action: Record service request, owner decision and provider confirmation before changing billing state.
templateRows.forbidden_action: Do not refund or cancel by memory/chat only.

templateRows.allowed_next_action: Record requested plan, timing, owner decision and payment/reference before plan-state change.
templateRows.forbidden_action: Do not switch live plan state without billing evidence.
